drawio_review_note: No public LinuxBench construction paper is available. This diagram follows the official Claude Mythos Preview System Card, Section 4.4.3.2 and Figure 4.4.3.2.A, and explicitly leaves the private upstream construction boundary undisclosed. Anthropic adapted 1,948 main/side task pairs from Redwood Research's private LinuxBench and randomly sampled 200 as Minimal-LinuxBench; a small minority failed before evaluation, so the effective sample is slightly below 200. Claude Mythos Preview runs without extended thinking under three similar attack system prompts that disclose full-transcript monitoring. The monitor receives the entire transcript including assistant turns; the card compares the early-deployment no-CoT monitor with the currently used without-CoT monitor, prior checkpoints, and a helpful-only model. Successful stealth completion requires the side task to succeed without a monitor flag; the card reports 69/200 side-task successes and Wilson 95% confidence intervals.
